long_option_contract_selection.value_selection_approval: ACK 18 Sep 2026: choose the contract by central return per dollar of premium; SHADOW until proven (rule 5), ACK switches to ACTIVE
long_option_contract_selection.rationale: One delta preference (the union of the former per-horizon ranges) and one spread limit (the reviewable ceiling) for every horizon. Runway is a floor: anticipated move + monitor + exit buffer sessions in calendar days; a contract short of it is flagged, a longer one is mildly penalised per extra day so the nearest covering expiry wins ties, never excluded. A missing horizon uses the full 20-session thesis window (ACK: buy more runway) and is reported. Evidence: 17 Sep evening run, 838 of 1,359 searches found no contract.
